ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: In the diagram, what label marks the central or principal vein of a leaf?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: On the right side of the image is a broad leaf, and in the leaf there is a relatively thick main line extending obliquely from the petiole/base to the leaf tip, with many thinner lateral vein branches around it. The letter M is located on the right side of the leaf, and its indication line points to this relatively thick main vein located in the center of the leaf. Reasoning: The central or principal vein of a leaf refers to the midrib/main vein, that is, the thick vein passing through the center of the leaf; the label pointing to this main vein in the image is M.
